== Notes ==
* If this enchantment is renewed before it ends, it will not disable your skills. Some ways to achieve this are:
** Rank 16 Divine Favor, [[Glyph of Swiftness]] and a [[perfect]] [[of Enchanting]] upgrade.
** Rank 15 Divine Favor, [[Blessed Aura]] and a perfect of Enchanting upgrade.
